rationale: The stock gapped down ~11.6% on an earnings beat with negative estimate revision trends, creating a wide-range day (low $185, high $208) with the current price at 82% of that range — suggesting a significant intraday recovery from the low but now sitting just below the 9-EMA ($205.15) with momentum stalling (last 5 candles show a drift lower from ~$205 to ~$204). The spread is manageable but the ATR is small relative to the day's range, and the price action lacks a clean directional setup — neither a confirmed breakout above the open/9-EMA nor a fresh breakdown below VWAP ($197.63). With 202 minutes to close and no clear mechanical edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
